headline: Global land mine casualties hit a five year high driven by Myanmar and Syria
label: NEWS
caption:
Global land mine casualties reached a five year high with children making up a large share of the victims according to new reports.

The surge in casualties is largely driven by conflicts and returning populations in Myanmar and Syria.

Data shows that thirty six percent of all land mine casualties are children.

Returning refugees face severe dangers from unexploded ordnance as they try to rebuild their lives in war torn areas.

How can governments and international b0dies better protect returning families from hidden explosives in conflict zones? 👇
